title: A layered double hydroxides/MXene composite based triboelectric nanogenerator for energy harvesting and self-powered electroplating applications
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,4364-4374
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00492F, Paper
Open Access

Navaneeth Madathil, Anjaly Babu, Mahesh Velupula, Anu Kulandaivel, Rakesh Kumar Rajaboina, Uday Kumar Khanapuram, Kamakshaiah Charyulu Devarayapalli, Dae Sung Lee
NiAl-LDH/MXene TENG achieved a power density of 36.9 W m−2, enabling efficient energy harvesting. It drives self-powered copper electroplating from biomechanical energy, highlighting promise for sustainable, eco-friendly electronics.
